papers.title: Pink noise in dyads’ semantic similarity trajectories predicts conversation enjoyment
papers.abstract: Conversation is a core component of human social life. Many influential theories treat conversation as a linear system, i.e., the sum of its parts. However, linear accounts of semantic entrainment lose explanatory power at their upper limits: Discussing perfectly aligned opinions becomes boring. We propose an alternate account that considers the multiscale organization of semantic similarity over the course of a conversation, as indexed by pink noise. Here, we test whether pink noise can be found in interlocutors' conavigated trajectories through semantic space. Not only is pink noise present,
papers.tldr_zh: 发现对话双方语义相似度轨迹呈粉红噪声，其强度可预测愉悦感与联结感，并随练习增强。

papers.title: Dreams of rebirth: revisiting China's AI imaginaries in the post-DeepSeek era
papers.abstract: This study examines how Chinese AI practitioners construct sociotechnical imaginaries around AI development in China amid intensifying the U.S.–China technological competition following DeepSeek's emergence in early 2025. Based on expert interviews ( N = 33), podcast analysis ( N = 65), and fieldwork across Beijing, Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Hong Kong, we find that DeepSeek's breakthrough catalyzed a reconfiguration of imaginaries across national, organizational, and individual scales: renewed confidence in China's capacity for technological advancement despite geopolitical constraints, revived
papers.tldr_zh: 基于访谈、播客与田野，分析DeepSeek后中国AI从业者围绕技术竞争重构的“重生主义”想象。

papers.title: Beyond proximity: How racial and income differences are reflected in mobility patterns across neighborhoods in American cities
papers.abstract: Abstract Although urban segregation has been widely studied, how race- and class-based neighborhood differences affect everyday mobility is less understood and in need of consistent metrics. Such social dimensions of travel are not reflected in conventional spatial accessibility measures or theoretical models of intra-urban mobility, potentially omitting an important aspect of travel behavior. Using Census Block Group–level cellphone mobility data from the 498 largest U.S. cities, we examine how differences in social characteristics between neighborhoods are manifested in where people travel w
papers.tldr_zh: 用498个美国城市手机移动数据，提出时间等效指标量化邻里种族与收入差异如何抑制跨社区出行。

papers.title: Receiver inference in relational event history data: Reconstructing communication networks with large language models
papers.abstract: Receiver inference is central to social network analysis because it reveals interaction dynamics such as participation structures, turn-taking patterns, and directed communication ties. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have improved the analysis of conversational data; however, their ability to recover sender–receiver structures from multi-party conversations, evaluate uncertainty in these predictions, and assess downstream consequences for relational event modeling remains underexplored. This study addresses this gap by evaluating GPT-4.1 for receiver inference in structured mu
papers.tldr_zh: 评估GPT-4.1从多方对话中推断接收者以重建有向通信网络，并与人工标注对比及考察下游建模影响。

papers.title: Who Goes Toxic? Understanding Political Toxicity on Social Media Across Individuals and Contexts
papers.abstract: As political toxicity has become widespread on social media, scholars have sought to understand what drives it. While studies often emphasize platform-level explanations, such as algorithmic amplification, they offer limited insight into which users are more likely to produce toxic content. Even less is known about how the relationship between individual-level factors and toxicity varies across political contexts. Using data from 184,354 randomly sampled U.S. Twitter (now X) users, their original tweets (25M), and the accounts they follow, we link users’ inferred characteristics and political
papers.tldr_zh: 用18万美国推特用户及其2500万条推文，将用户特征与政治语境关联到真实毒性发帖行为，发现共和党、男性、年长者更常发布不礼貌和不宽容内容。

papers.title: CasHyper: Modeling Multi-Factor Interactions and Asymmetric Influence in Cascade Prediction via Hypercomplex Algebra
papers.abstract: Cascade prediction aims to forecast the future evolution of information diffusion and is an important task in social network analysis. Most existing methods represent users and cascades in real-valued Euclidean spaces, which may offer limited capacity to model multi-factor interactions and asymmetric influence in complex diffusion processes. To address these challenges, we propose CasHyper, a hypercomplex-based cascade prediction framework that integrates hypercomplex algebra with graph neural networks and Transformers. CasHyper organizes user and cascade embeddings into multiple hypercomplex
papers.tldr_zh: 提出CasHyper框架，用超复数代数结合GNN与Transformer建模级联扩散中的多因素交互与非对称影响，提升信息级联预测。

papers.title: The Popular Get More Popular: Auditing Brand Bias in Generative Search
papers.abstract: The shift from traditional to generative search has fundamentally transformed online product discovery. Because conversational recommendations synthesize choices into a few direct answers, subtle systemic preferences toward specific providers can exert profound commercial impacts. In this work, we audit this phenomenon through two distinct dimensions: (i) brand popularity bias, the systematic preference for market-dominant entities over long-tail alternatives, and (ii) brand familiarity bias, the ranking advantage an entity encoded in an LLM's parametric memory holds over an unfamiliar competi
papers.tldr_zh: 审计生成式搜索中的品牌偏见，发现主流品牌被引用频率是平均的1.4至2.8倍，且LLM参数记忆带来熟悉度排名优势。

papers.title: How Generative AI Redefines Personalization and Diversity in the Newsroom
papers.abstract: The tension between news personalization and information diversity has traditionally been understood as a matter of different content reaching different people, with diversity evaluated by the range of sources, topics, and perspectives to which audiences are exposed. Generative AI outdates this understanding, since it transforms personalization in two ways: how journalists adapt news to audiences and how the AI tools journalists use personalize content production to their own preferences. Drawing on 16 semi-structured interviews with media professionals across public service, commercial, and s
papers.tldr_zh: 基于16位媒体从业者访谈，分析生成式AI如何重塑新闻个性化与信息多样性及编辑判断。

papers.title: Current frontiers in mobility and well-being
papers.abstract: Human mobility has a profound impact on social structure and collective behavior, which allows individuals to reshape group structures in response to strategy information, acting as a double-edged sword for cooperative behavior. It can both disrupt existing cooperative communities and enable individuals to escape adverse environments and seek high-quality interaction partners. This paper surveys current research progress on the impact of mobility on cooperation within the framework of evolutionary game theory, focusing on specific mechanisms of passive escape, dynamic self-organization driven
papers.tldr_zh: 综述演化博弈框架下移动性对合作的影响，聚焦被动逃离、主动自组织及迁移成本与速度的权衡。

papers.title: Efficiently Estimating Cycle Statistics on Graphs via Spanning Trees
papers.abstract: Simple cycles encode feedback and alternative routes in networks and are important for routing problems, the convergence of dynamical processes on networks, message passing and belief propagation, or even static network characterizations such as structural balance in signed networks. Being able to assess and sample from the cycle structure of a graph is thus of interest in many analysis contexts. However, due to the combinatorial growth of the cycle space with graph size, the computational cost for such sampling is high. Therefore, we here introduce a sampling framework that enables us to samp
papers.tldr_zh: 提出基于均匀生成树的采样框架，无需枚举即可高效估计与采样图中的环结构统计量。

papers.title: AraEngage: Interpretable Linguistic Correlates of Engagement in Arabic Facebook News
papers.abstract: Engagement features developed for English are routinely applied to Arabic, but unvocalized Arabic changes what a lexical feature measures. We introduce AraEngage, a query-defined sample of 10,000 public Arabic Facebook news posts from 2,451 pages in 57 countries (2023-2024) that pairs engagement counts with interpretable linguistic features. We use it to examine which interpretable Arabic indicators are associated with follower-normalized engagement, and how far those associations can be trusted given publisher context, the definition of engagement, and lexical ambiguity. papers.tldr_zh: 构建1万条阿拉伯语Facebook新闻帖数据集，用可解释语言特征和随机森林加SHAP分析哪些语言指标与归一化互动量相关。

papers.title: Code, Commits, and Complexity in the GenAI Era: A Longitudinal Study of Team-Based Capstone Projects
papers.abstract: Generative AI tools are now widely available to students, but little is known about how team-based project codebases have changed since they appeared. This matters when project courses use repository activity as evidence of progress and learning. Existing studies have largely examined self-reports, controlled tasks, or short individual assignments, leaving open questions around how student codebases evolve in authentic project settings. We present a ten-semester analysis of N=260 capstone team repositories from 2021 to 2025, spanning pre- and post-AI cohorts. We examine three dimensions: code
papers.tldr_zh: 分析260个毕业设计团队仓库十学期数据，发现GenAI普及后代码规模、复杂度与提交行为发生变化。

papers.title: Replicability, Reproducibility, and Robustness in Political and Social Science Research with Large Language Models
papers.abstract: This chapter addresses the central reproducibility problem of research with large language models. LLM output is probabilistic and varies across models and versions, which can have significant effects on downstream statistical results. The chapter distinguishes between replicability, reproducibility, and robustness, and proposes a probabilistic standard based on the distribution of results, not identical outputs. It introduces a standardized prompt script, tests within-model variation for encoders and decoders, and develops error-structure analysis to diagnose where models err and whether thei
papers.tldr_zh: 提出LLM研究可复现性框架，区分可复制、可复现与稳健性，发现测量选择可反转回归系数符号。

papers.title: Does Personality Persuade? Investigating Personality Trait Prompting and Persuasion in Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can be prompted to express different personality profiles, but it remains unclear how reliably they do so or whether personality affects their persuasiveness. We investigate these questions in two evaluations. First, we assess Big Five personality prompting using the IPIP-NEO-120, examining reproducibility, trait controllability, cross-trait effects, and unconditioned model profiles. Second, we conduct a within-subjects user study (N=32) in which participants discuss moral dilemmas with LLM agents whose personalities are aligned, mismatched, neutral, or uncondition
papers.tldr_zh: 检验LLM大五人格提示的可控性，并用32人实验发现人格设定影响其说服效果。

papers.title: Who Gets Counted? Large Language Models, Informative Refusal, and Downstream Bias in Name-Based Demographic Classification
papers.abstract: Researchers routinely infer gender, race, and ethnicity from names, yet the standard tools used for this task misclassify the groups that diversity research most needs to measure. Large language models (LLMs) have been proposed as a remedy because they label diverse names accurately. We ask whether that accuracy carries over to the estimates researchers report. Across 10,000 Chinese names, 19,998 North Carolina voters with self-reported race, and 300 political science authors with human reference codes, we compare three LLMs with seven traditional tools and link the voter sample to party regis
papers.tldr_zh: 比较三种LLM与七种传统工具从姓名推断人口特征，发现LLM准确率部分源于选择性标注并带来下游偏差。

papers.title: Follow or Surpass? Collaboration, Sound, and the Recognition of Influence in Lineages of Jazz Trumpet Players
papers.abstract: Cultural fields cohere not only horizontally, through collaboration, but also vertically, through lineages of artistic influence. Considerable attention has been devoted to collaboration networks in various fields of creative production; however, we know less about the structure of artistic influence that is nevertheless key to individual artistic development and the evolution of genres. We examine the structure of such an influence network in a genealogy of 52 prominent jazz trumpet players, combining musicians' discographies, demographic characteristics, geographical locations, and audio ana
papers.tldr_zh: 用唱片、人口、地理与音频数据构建52位爵士小号手的师承影响网络，以ERGM发现合作、合作者重叠与音色相似共同塑造影响力认可。

papers.title: How Rich is the Rich-Club? Super Rich-Club Organization in Complex Networks
papers.abstract: The rich-club coefficient is used in complex networks to quantify the tendency of progressively higher-degree nodes to be more densely connected than expected by chance. However, it does not capture whether high degree nodes towards the core are actually more interconnected than the original network. Here, we jointly analyze the rich-club coefficient and an enrichment coefficient, which quantifies whether the internal average degree of progressively higher-degree subgraphs is greater than that of the original network, despite the decreasing number of nodes. We apply this framework to real and
papers.tldr_zh: 联合分析rich-club系数与富集系数，在真实与合成网络中揭示三类核心组织模式，区分高阶节点是否真正更紧密互联。

papers.title: Emergent regularity of walking patterns: evidence from Swiss cities
papers.abstract: Human travel behaviour is characterised by high temporal and spatial regularity, as demonstrated by the Exploration and Preferential Return (EPR) mechanism, whereby individuals alternate between exploring new locations and preferentially returning to previously visited places. Yet, existing evidence is based on aggregated mobility data that cannot distinguish short trips or separate active mobility (i.e., walking and biking) from other mobility modes. This limits our ability to assess the benefits of walking activities and proximity-based policies such as the 15-minute city. Here, we analyse t
papers.tldr_zh: 分析瑞士主要城市1318人四周步行轨迹，发现步行模式呈现探索-优先返回的规律性，支持15分钟城市邻近性政策。

papers.title: Community Search under Member-Specific Tolerances
papers.abstract: We study community search when each vertex has its own tolerance for differences in position. For positions such as opinions or homes, a latitude-consistent community (LCC) contains the query vertex, is connected, has minimum degree at least k, and bounds its diameter by the smallest member tolerance. Motivated by social judgment theory, the bound exactly characterizes persistent acceptance of every interaction in a closed group under bounded-confidence dynamics with arbitrary positive weights. papers.tldr_zh: 提出成员容忍度约束下的社区搜索问题，证明最大LCC求解NP难，并给出LatSweep算法。

papers.title: The Male Abstraction Bias in Internet Culture and Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Two foundational aspects of human cognition, abstractness and gender, are typically examined as separable. Here, we find they are systematically linked throughout the entire space of concepts spanning single (N = 40,000) and multi-word expressions (N = 67,000): across billions of words and millions of images on the internet -- and across numerous measurement techniques -- more abstract concepts are more associated with men, an effect which replicates in languages around the world. This pattern not only holds across conceptual domains, but it also maps onto grammatical structure: verbs and adve
papers.tldr_zh: 分析数十亿词与数百万图像，发现抽象概念更关联男性，该偏差跨语言复现并出现在LLM自由联想中。

papers.title: AGORA cities: the hidden infrastructure shaping urban fragility
papers.abstract: Urban services are unevenly distributed across the city, yet it is unclear when their joint presence signals fragility and when it instead outlines a neighbourhood's vocation. For Bologna and Florence, we integrate Foursquare and OpenStreetMap points of interest with Sentinel-2-derived green indicators based on the 3-30-300 rule, cluster urban areas accordingly, and benchmark the clusters against the demographic, social, economic and composite fragility indices produced by the municipal statistical offices, which are exogenous to the analysis. In both cities, we identify a subset of infrastruc
papers.tldr_zh: 整合Foursquare、OSM兴趣点与绿地指标对博洛尼亚和佛罗伦萨城市区域聚类，发现艺术、绿地与可达路径等设施共现与较低城市脆弱性相关。

papers.title: A Cracked Mirror: How People Perceive Gender Performance by Large Language Models
papers.abstract: How do large language models (LLMs) perform gender under zero-shot prompting, and how do people interpret those performances in conversation? Drawing on gender performativity, we examine how gendered meanings emerge through generated language, conversational context and human interpretation. In a preregistered randomised online experiment, 1,060 participants each had five short conversations with an LLM. papers.tldr_zh: 1060人预注册在线实验与LLM进行五轮对话，发现模型性别表现随提示偏移但极端值趋中，人对性别感知受对话语境影响。

papers.title: Measuring Model-Specific Alignment Drift in LLM-Based Opinion Dynamics
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly used as synthetic participants in opinion-dynamics experiments, often assuming that an agent's behaviour is fully determined by its prompt. We test this assumption with a framework in which LLM agents discuss a contested policy issue over repeated rounds while their stance is quantified by a fixed psychometric instrument independent of any dynamics model. papers.tldr_zh: 用六种LLM智能体多轮讨论争议政策，发现立场漂移由互动引发且因模型而异。

papers.title: BaCon: Band-Concentrated Exponential Random Graph Models
papers.abstract: Exponential-family random graph models ERGMs provide a parametric interpretable framework for modeling real graphs including the Web and social networks Fitted ERGMs may suffer from degeneracy matching observed graph statistics in expectation does not guarantee that the observed graph and similar ones are highly probable under the fitted distribution We introduce Band-Concentrated ERGMs BaCon a framework that avoids degeneracy by imposing a probabilistic constraint requiring at least $1-δ$ of the distribution probability mass to lie on the set of graphs with statistics within an $\varepsilon$-
papers.tldr_zh: 提出Band-Concentrated ERGM，用统计量容差带约束避免模型退化，保持最大熵指数族形式。

papers.title: Interpretable Social Network Churn Prediction via Ergodic Markov Chains
papers.abstract: Predicting social network churn before it becomes visible in aggregate metrics remains an open challenge, particularly in enterprise settings where heterogeneous usage patterns, sparse data, and deployment constraints preclude standard supervised approaches. We formalize this problem as finite-step engagement projection over contributor-role Markov chains, with a stationary-distribution interpretation for ergodic chains in the long-run limit. papers.tldr_zh: 用贡献者角色马尔可夫链做六步传播，实现无标签的社会网络流失预测。

papers.title: Modelling lock-in of AI adoption through skill erosion
papers.abstract: Generative AI can improve immediate performance but may erode the human skills required for future work. We study a model in which individuals tend to imitate successful peers, while their independent skills grow with practice and erode with reliance on AI. Because each agent's skill reflects their history, non-users and AI users develop different skill distributions, which we derive exactly. Skill erosion can produce bistability and hysteresis between a low-adoption, high-skill state and a high-adoption, low-skill state. papers.tldr_zh: 建模同伴模仿与技能侵蚀，发现AI采用存在双稳态与滞后，单用户扩散条件不对称。

papers.title: When Debate Amplifies Risk: Social-Bias Vulnerabilities in Multi-Agent Safety Deliberation
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented Web applications increasingly employ multi-agent debate (MAD) to aggregate conflicting, noisy, and heterogeneous information, yet deliberation is fundamentally a social process susceptible to interpersonal dynamics. When retrieved Web sources contain latent hazards alongside safe factual content, social biases such as conformity pressure and authority deference can override evidence-grounded safety boundaries. papers.tldr_zh: 发现多智能体辩论中的从众与权威偏见会放大检索网页中的潜在安全风险。

papers.title: Social media ban for minors: a computational analysis of media coverage in Europe and beyond
papers.abstract: This study examined global media portrayals of social media bans for minors, focusing on dominant narratives, framing dimensions, and persuasion techniques. We compiled a multilingual dataset of 10,509 articles from mainstream media and unverified online sources published between 1 January 2024 and 15 March 2025 in 24 EU languages, Arabic, Chinese, Georgian, Russian, and Ukrainian. papers.tldr_zh: 分析24种语言万余篇报道，发现非欧盟媒体对未成年人社媒禁令更多政治化框架与煽动语言。

papers.title: Trail systems self-organize through individual route optimization
papers.abstract: As animals, including humans, walk, they compact the vegetation and ground beneath them, reducing the cost of movement for subsequent travelers. From this positive feedback emerge networks of trails which allow for efficient movement and store generational-scale information about the environment. Models simulating this process show how individuals following local cues produce trail systems with many of the features of real-world networks. However, little has been done to investigate walkers with more complete knowledge of their environment and the abilities to plan their behavior intelligently
papers.tldr_zh: 构建个体路径成本最小化的通用模型，仿真再现真实小径网络的多样复杂结构。

papers.title: Whose startup does the AI back? An algorithm audit of reputation and demographic signals in LLM-assisted crowdfunding
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) assistants increasingly advise backers on which crowdfunding campaigns to support. LLMs have known race and gender problems, and it is unsettled whether they reproduce, erase, or reverse the discrimination documented in entrepreneurial finance. We ask when, and through which decision process, LLM assistants use founders' gender and ethnicity. papers.tldr_zh: 对七个LLM做众筹选择联合实验，发现默认情形下创始人性别与族裔影响甚微。

papers.title: Labtune: Treating Lab Organization and Information Sharing as Experimental Variables in LLM-Agent Discovery
papers.abstract: De-siloing can create groupthink; silos can prevent knowledge sharing and reduce research efficiency. The same tension appears in research systems built with large language model (LLM) agents, yet their organization is usually fixed by design. I propose treating laboratory structure and information sharing as experimental variables. I introduce Labtune, an open framework for bounded research workflows with user-selected laboratory organization, communication policy, model configuration and budget. papers.tldr_zh: 提出Labtune框架，把实验室组织结构与信息共享设为LLM智能体科研流程的可调实验变量。

papers.title: Algorithmic Intervention Decreases Polarization in Content Moderation
papers.abstract: Crowd-based moderation relies on people's collective judgments to combat misinformation, but raters bring their own ideological biases to the task, shaping how they moderate each other's contributions. We ask whether an algorithmic redesign can counteract this bias, using X's Community Notes, where contributors write context for potentially misleading posts and rate each other's notes. Community Notes replaced simple majority voting with an algorithm that instead rewards agreement across people with different ideological viewpoints. Comparing 8,805 notes and 4,367 contributors before and after
papers.tldr_zh: 比较X社区笔记算法改动前后，发现跨立场共识算法降低了贡献者与笔记的意识形态极化。

papers.title: Discovering hierarchical governing equations for community-structured complex network dynamics with LLM agents
papers.abstract: Governing equations provide an interpretable description of the mechanisms underlying complex network dynamics, yet their discovery from observational data remains challenging when shared community-level dynamics coexist with individual-level variations and the relevant functional structures may be absent from the initial candidate library or not explicitly specified in advance. Here we formulate this task as a hierarchical law-discovery problem and introduce SAGE, a large language model-guided self-reflective agent framework for discovering community-shared governing laws and individual-speci
papers.tldr_zh: 提出SAGE框架，用LLM智能体迭代发现社区结构复杂网络的共享与个体动力学方程。

papers.title: Susceptibility optimization for wisdom of crowds: A social power reformulation and realization framework
papers.abstract: Whether social influence makes a crowd wiser or more biased hinges on who yields to others and who holds firm. Such heterogeneous susceptibilities to social influence, together with the influence network, determine the weight each agent's initial estimate carries in the collective estimate, known as social power. This paper studies susceptibility optimization for maximizing the wisdom of crowds under the Friedkin-Johnsen model. papers.tldr_zh: 在Friedkin-Johnsen模型下优化个体对社会影响的易感性，通过社会权力重构框架最小化集体偏差以提升群体智慧。

papers.title: Inferring missing locations in human mobility data using memory effects
papers.abstract: Empirical datasets used to characterize human mobility are sparse in space and time, owing to technological factors such as coverage and battery, or to the erratic nature of online interactions. Missing data can bias the conclusions drawn from them, so filling the gaps in incomplete timelines is a key challenge in computational social science. Here, we propose a simple imputation method in which the informativeness of an observation decays with its bidirectional temporal distance from the missing entry, at a rate set by a single parameter per individual. papers.tldr_zh: 提出基于双向时间距离幂律衰减的缺失位置填补法，在Twitter数据上AUROC超0.9。

papers.title: No Note Is an Island: Probing LLMs' Understanding of Crowdsourced Fact-Checking Environments
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly assist crowdsourced fact-checking, yet evaluations focus on individual annotations. A correction's reach and reception depend on visibility, audience responses, and platform policies. We introduce correction context understanding: assessing corrective content, interpreting audience responses, and reasoning about platform dynamics within a shared environment. We build NoteHabitat from 36 months of Weibo Annotations data, linking 102,994 posts (42,853 annotations), 431,407 comments, and five policy events. Evaluating diverse model families across seven t
papers.tldr_zh: 基于微博36个月数据构建NoteHabitat，评估LLM对众包事实核查环境中内容、互动与平台动态的理解，发现标注质量与互动弱相关等三类差距。

papers.title: AgenticMobility: An Open-Source Platform for Multi-AI-Agent Mobility Dynamics
papers.abstract: Understanding mobility dynamics and the effects of urban transportation management policies requires examining how individual travel decisions, traffic conditions, and policy interventions influence one another over time. We present AgenticMobility, an open-source experimental platform for studying how mobility AI agents and other AI agents interact, adapt through repeated experience, and collectively shape mobility outcomes. papers.tldr_zh: 开源多LLM智能体出行仿真平台，智能体重复决策并共同塑造城市交通结果。

papers.title: A Common Language for Dynamic Graphs: Interaction Tokenization Enables Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Dynamic graphs capture evolving interactions in Web systems, including online communication, user engagement, and recommendation. Graph foundation models aim to reuse predictive capabilities across networks, but extending this capability to dynamic graphs faces two challenges. First, node identities are graph-specific, and similar interaction patterns can appear at different temporal and activity scales, making histories difficult to represent consistently across networks. papers.tldr_zh: 提出交互分词方法为动态图构建通用语言，使基础模型可跨网络迁移预测在线交互行为。

papers.title: LLMs and the Organization of Scientific Work
papers.abstract: The advent of large language models (LLMs) represents a technological revolution for science. Their diffusion may reshape not only how scientists conduct research, but also how they organize their work within teams. Here, we develop a conceptual framework in which LLMs expand individual capabilities across a range of research activities, reducing reliance on complementary human inputs within tasks and facilitating a more specialized division of labor among team members. We further propose that teams' history of collaboration may constrain their ability to reorganize in response to the new tech
papers.tldr_zh: 用约12万篇PLOS ONE贡献声明，分析LLM扩散如何改变科研团队分工与协作历史的影响。

papers.title: Networked Synthetic Social Engineering on the Web
papers.abstract: Several genuine AI services may repeat one unsupported source, and correcting that source may leave later reports unchanged. We examine these networked consequences of synthetic social engineering (SSE), deliberately misleading influence intended to redirect AI recipients from authorized objectives. Our framework connects social influence, information aggregation, and misinformation correction research to observable evidence and permission boundaries. It separates originating attempts from legitimate intermediaries' work and distinguishes identity, evidentiary support, and authorization. We te
papers.tldr_zh: 构建多智能体服务交换框架，用Qwen3-4B测试合成社会工程中错误信息经多个发布者网络化传播与纠错失效。

papers.title: How Green Is Your Manifesto? Scoring Environmental Positions in the 2024 EU Elections with an LLM Panel
papers.abstract: Locating political parties on environmental and climate policy is central to the study of party competition, yet the established instruments, expert surveys and the hand coding of manifestos, are costly, periodic, and slow to extend to new documents. We ask whether a panel of large language models can serve as a cheaper and reproducible alternative. Treating each manifesto as a set of sentences, three models from independent providers score every sentence on two dimensions, environmental protection and climate change, separating a party's position on an issue from the salience it gives it, and
papers.tldr_zh: 用三家LLM组成评审团对2024欧盟选举41份宣言逐句打分，测量政党环境立场与议题显著性。

papers.title: Behind the organizational chart: The emergence of “gurus” in advice networks
papers.abstract: Explaining the endogenous emergence of “gurus” – high-status professionals who are referred to for advice but are unlikely to seek it themselves – in organizations requires an integrated approach. This approach must consider the interplay of individual attributes (e.g., skills and status), structural factors (e.g., informal networks), and organizational contexts (e.g., knowledge-sharing infrastructure and internal competitiveness) from a dynamic perspective. In this study, we develop an agent-based model of advice network formation calibrated on an empirically observed network to identify the
papers.tldr_zh: 构建基于实证网络校准的智能体模型，发现地位差异、同质性和组织竞争环境驱动组织建议网络中“导师”型人物的涌现。

papers.title: Agreement Helps, Disagreement Matters: Scaling Framing Function Annotation With Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Framing research has long relied on human annotation, but many aspects of framing – especially framing functions such as defining problems, identifying causes, making moral evaluations, or proposing solutions are difficult to label consistently and at scale. We demonstrate that large language models can reliably identify these framing functions, achieving levels of agreement comparable to those of human annotators. We evaluate three state-of-the-art models (GPT-5, Claude 3.7, and DeepSeek) alongside three trained human coders on a new dataset of social media posts about electric-vehicles, a hi
papers.tldr_zh: 用GPT-5、Claude 3.7和DeepSeek与人工编码者对比标注电动车议题帖子的框架功能，发现LLM可靠性接近人类。

papers.title: Datafication meets democracy: Epistemic distrust and data-driven campaigns in India
papers.abstract: While scholarship on data-driven campaigning has grown in recent years, the processes through which data is produced and how it translates to decision-making remain under-theorised. Drawing on ethnographic fieldwork conducted inside the campaign war room of a major political party during the 2022 Punjab Assembly elections in India, I examine the quotidian practices through which campaign data was collected, processed and rendered actionable. The article argues that democratic politics represents an arena where datafication indexes not an absolute faith in the power of numbers, but coexists wit
papers.tldr_zh: 基于印度旁遮普邦选举竞选作战室田野调查，提出“认知不信任”概念解释数据化竞选中的数据生产与决策。

papers.title: FinTime-Fuse: a multimodal LLM for aligning news and financial time-series in enhanced forecasting
papers.abstract: Accurate financial time series forecasting hinges on effectively integrating both numerical price data and external textual signals, such as news events. While Time-LLM provides a cross-modal time-series prediction mechanism for price sequences, our main contribution focuses on a novel method to fuse these time-series embeddings with learned representations of news text within a large language model (LLM) framework. In contrast to traditional approaches, often relying on text-only training or simple numeric similarity for retrieval, our method leverages the LLM’s capacity to capture intricate
papers.tldr_zh: 提出FinTime-Fuse多模态LLM，将新闻文本表示与金融时间序列嵌入融合以改进价格预测。

papers.title: Reversing Polarization through Tolerance-Aware Recommendation and Adaptive Diversification
papers.abstract: Recommender systems face a tension between broadening exposure to diverse viewpoints and avoiding interactions that reinforce extreme positions. This tension is especially consequential in already polarized populations. Here we investigate whether recommendation strategies can reverse polarization rather than merely slow its development. Building on the Attraction--Repulsion Model of opinion dynamics, we introduce two complementary design principles: Tolerance-aware recommendation, which seeks to learn each individual's tolerance for disagreement and reduces exposure to viewpoints beyond that
papers.tldr_zh: 基于吸引-排斥舆论动力学，提出容忍度感知推荐与自适应多样化策略，智能体实验显示可逆转极化。

papers.title: Spreading Dynamics on Higher-Order Networks: A Structure-Mechanism-Behavior Perspective with Applications
papers.abstract: Spreading in real-world networks, including modern communication and networked systems, often unfolds through group interactions rather than isolated pairwise contacts. Higher-order network representations such as simplicial complexes, hypergraphs, and their temporal, multilayer, and directed extensions provide a principled way to encode group interactions. Unfortunately, existing studies on spreading over these substrates remain fragmented and largely model-centric, offering limited insight into how higher-order representations and contagion mechanisms jointly shape emergent dynamics. This re
papers.tldr_zh: 综述高阶网络上的传播动力学，提出结构-机制-行为三层视角系统映射群体交互下的涌现动态。

papers.title: BiliPicks: Seven Years of Weekly Platform Curation on Bilibili with Video Metadata, Comments, and Danmaku
papers.abstract: BiliPicks documents seven years of Bilibili's Weekly Picks, a platform-curated editorial video series. The dataset covers 371 publicly listed issues and 13,758 curated videos from 22 March 2019 to 7 May 2026. It links issue dates, themes and editorial recommendations to video metadata, 47,799,657 top-level comments, 125,690,760 time-synchronised overlay comments (danmaku), and 13,739 cover images. Weekly issues provide a consistent unit for tracing changes in category composition, recurring creators and editorial framing. Corresponding comments and danmaku connect video-level discussion with a
papers.tldr_zh: 发布B站七年“每周必看”策展数据集，含1.37万视频、4780万评论与1.26亿弹幕，支持纵向分析。

papers.title: Statistical Detectability of Coordination
papers.abstract: Information operations exploit coordinated activity on social media to amplify messages and manipulate public discourse. A common approach to coordination detection is to project account-entity interactions into account similarity networks based on temporal proximity, action counts, or behavioural similarity, and identify dense subgraphs or behavioural clusters. However, the current methodology finds groups of co-activated accounts or partitions all users into most similarly acting clusters, even when the accounts are acting independently of each other or the co-activity is due to some expecte
papers.tldr_zh: 将协同行为检测形式化为账号对假设检验，比较零模型并联系植入子矩阵检测理论。

papers.title: Who Owns Digital News, and Who Gets Cited: Measuring Media Concentration Across 77 Countries and Seven AI Systems
papers.abstract: Digital news outlets compete for audience attention. Search engines equipped with generative AI systems such as Google's AI overviews increasingly decide where that attention goes, as well as the revenue it represents. Yet, the lack of a consistent data collection infrastructure between national-level regulatory bodies has hindered between-country comparative analysis of media concentration, and with it any assessment of how these intermediaries reshape digital news markets. To address this issue, we compile an ownership dataset for 9,761 digital news outlets drawn from Wikipedia and Wikidata,
papers.tldr_zh: 用维基数据构建77国9761家数字新闻媒体所有权数据集，测算流量加权集中度并考察AI系统引用格局。

papers.title: Revisiting Temporal Link Prediction through Structural Proximity
papers.abstract: Existing temporal link prediction methods typically rely on learned temporal representations to capture evolving interaction patterns. In this paper, we show that a classical structural proximity measure can match or outperform these methods without training or learned temporal sequence modeling. We revisit Personalized PageRank (PPR) on historical interaction graphs, using simple sliding-window retention or exponential time decay. Surprisingly, across 14 datasets, Time-decay PPR ranks first on nine and second on four among the compared methods, including datasets with few repeated edges. To u
papers.tldr_zh: 发现带时间衰减的个性化PageRank在14个数据集上多数优于学习式时序链路预测方法。

papers.title: Solitary movement style predicts collective foraging while whom to follow emerges only in company
papers.abstract: How far can behaviour inside a group, and the group's performance, be predicted from members measured while alone? We tested this on three public datasets of human collective foraging (621, 128 and 1,133 participants). A low-dimensional individual representation estimated from private-phase movement was mapped onto behaviour inside the group through a mapping learned on other participants. Private information processing was stable between the two halves of a session (split-half reliability, the correlation between the halves, 0.60--0.83) and predicted behaviour inside the group with correlatio
papers.tldr_zh: 用三个集体觅食数据集发现，独处时的移动风格可预测群体内行为，但“跟随谁”只在群体中才显现。

papers.title: Crowds Believe in You: Online Prediction Markets Overestimate How Often People Achieve Their Own Goals
papers.abstract: People increasingly share personal goals online and invite others to forecast them. Research on the planning fallacy finds that observers predict a person's behavior less optimistically than the person does, and prediction markets aggregate such judgments, harnessing the wisdom of crowds. We study 6,150 prediction markets on Manifold in which 1,660 users asked about their own futures ("Will I ...?"), reconstruct every order and execution, and compare these self-markets with markets about external events. Self-markets resolved YES 4.4 percentage points less often than their final prices implied
papers.tldr_zh: 分析Manifold上6150个预测市场，发现关于个人目标的自我市场比外部事件市场更常落空，群体过于乐观。

papers.title: The Price of a Chance in Artificial Societies
papers.abstract: Rapid advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled autonomous agents to interact, coordinate, and pursue individual goals in artificial societies. However, our understanding of how reward structures shape their competitive behavior and collective outcomes remains incomplete. We simulate 200 LLM agents competing over 50 rounds to maximize individual wealth. We define overcompetition and lying flat as population investment above and below a Bayesian adaptive baseline, respectively. At the lowest tested reward, populations lie flat; at the two highest, they overcompete, most strongly at
papers.tldr_zh: 模拟200个LLM智能体50轮竞争，发现低奖励下躺平、高奖励下过度竞争，中间覆盖率最激烈。

papers.title: Finding Is Not Returning, Returning Is Not Reconstructing: A Multi-Dimensional Evaluation of Agent Social Re-entry
papers.abstract: As Large Language Model (LLM) agents increasingly participate in persistent social environments, understanding their long-term social interaction capabilities becomes increasingly important. While existing research has advanced long-term memory and conversational context retrieval, less attention has been paid to whether agents can autonomously re-engage with previously inactive conversations. In particular, remembering a past interaction does not necessarily mean that an agent can identify when to revisit it, decide to return, or reconstruct the context needed for a coherent continuation. To
papers.tldr_zh: 提出LLM智能体社交再进入的多维评测，区分发现、返回与重构三种能力。

papers.title: Mechanisms reinforcing and countering segregation: How existing friendship and dislike ties impact friendship homophily and dislike heterophily among Muslim and non-Muslim students in German schools
papers.abstract: Homophily is an important social force in many social networks. While homophilous tendencies among positive relations (such as friendship) and heterophilous tendencies in negative tie networks (such as dislike) have been extensively studied, less is known about how such tendencies might become stronger or weaker as a result of past experiences. Focusing on homophilous and heterophilous tendencies between non-Muslim and Muslim students in schools, this paper explores whether, in line with Intergroup Contact Theory , existing friendship connections with outgroup members will reduce their inclina
papers.tldr_zh: 用德国学校穆斯林与非穆斯林学生的追踪网络数据，检验既有友谊与厌恶关系如何强化或削弱友谊同质性与厌恶异质性。

papers.title: Decoupling Procedural and Outcome Fairness in Seed Allocation for Influence Maximization
papers.abstract: On online social platforms, equal seed access to interventions can yield unequal group outcomes through social spillovers, so an access audit alone can miss outcome disparities. We characterise this trade-off through an exact allocation-structure decomposition and a sharp first-moment floor for graph-independent seeding under additive spillovers on stochastic block networks. Decoupled Procedural Allocation (DPA) combines group quotas with selection by seeds' contributions to each group's outcome. Rankings balance total outcome against disparity, and within-quota exchanges reduce the gap. Compu
papers.tldr_zh: 提出解耦程序公平与结果公平的影响力最大化种子分配方法，在随机块网络上量化溢出导致的结果差距并给出可计算界。

papers.title: Activity-based temporal hypergraphs: from individual activity to collective social dynamics
papers.abstract: Temporal hypergraphs provide an interesting representation for many social systems, as they integrate both the temporal and group nature of social interactions. Designing models of time-varying hyper-networks yields thus a convenient way to generate surrogates of empirical social systems, to understand the mechanisms underlying their emergent properties, and to investigate the evolution of dynamical processes taking place on such structures. Here, we focus on a specific and powerful class of these models, the activity-based temporal hypergraphs. We show how activity mechanisms provide control
papers.tldr_zh: 综述并构建基于活动的时间超图模型，用活动机制控制集体社会动力学时间尺度并刻画个体行为异质性。

papers.title: Neighborhood Deprivation Shapes Post-Flood Population Losses in Pune and Bandung
papers.abstract: Disaster research in high-income settings shows that better-resourced communities see population inflows and faster recovery, while disadvantaged communities suffer prolonged population loss. Whether this pattern holds in rapidly urbanizing cities of the Global South remains unclear. Here we show, using mobile phone data from Pune, India, and Bandung, Indonesia, how neighborhood-level changes in phone presence, a proxy for short-term population movement, relate to flooding and neighborhood deprivation. We combine satellite-derived flood maps with phone records to compare flooded and non-floode
papers.tldr_zh: 用印度浦那和印尼万隆的手机数据发现，洪水后贫困程度低的社区手机存在量上升、贫困社区下降，揭示灾害恢复的资源不平等。

papers.title: Rare, Relevant, and Still Wrong: How Memory Fails LLM Group Decisions
papers.abstract: When an LLM group's discussion is compressed into a short memory for a final decision maker, what should the memory keep? Two natural heuristics keep the rarest claims or the claims relevant to the decision criteria. On hidden-profile tasks both look attractive, because how widely a fact is held is confounded with whether it helps. We introduce CrossProfile, a diagnostic benchmark of 60 templates with automatically verified answer keys, in which the ownership of supporting, decoy, and irrelevant facts is crossed while their text is held fixed (480 tasks). Across Qwen2.5-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, and t
papers.tldr_zh: 构建CrossProfile基准测试LLM群体决策中的记忆压缩，发现按稀有性或相关性筛选记忆都会系统性保留错误信息。

papers.title: Multi-Scale Spatio-Temporal Exploratory Analysis of Urban Vehicle Theft
papers.abstract: Vehicle theft is a persistent urban problem with large economic and social costs. We analyze 521,098 stolen-vehicle reports filed with the Los Angeles Police Department from 2000 to 2022, at scales from hours to decades and from 100 m grid cells to census tracts. Much of the work lies in making the administrative records fit for analysis: we separate thefts from recoveries and traffic reports filed in the same records, repair time fields, validate the geocoding, and harmonize census data across changing tract boundaries. Theft is strongly and persistently concentrated: 10.8% of 250 m cells hol
papers.tldr_zh: 分析洛杉矶2000-2022年52万起盗车记录，发现盗车在250米网格和少数普查区高度持续聚集，且时空邻近案件多于随机预期。

papers.title: CogArena: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents on Interactive Behavioral Experiments
papers.abstract: Claims about the cognitive capabilities of large language models are typically tested by translating behavioral paradigms into text prompts, bypassing the visual interfaces and time pressure through which human participants actually engage with experiments. At the same time, AI agents can now complete online behavioral tasks and produce human-like data, which raises concerns that online datasets in the social and behavioral sciences are increasingly open to contamination. We introduce CogArena, a benchmark of ten experimental paradigms from the social and behavioral sciences. Agents complete t
papers.tldr_zh: 构建CogArena基准，让多模态智能体通过浏览器完成十项社会行为实验，并评估其类人程度与数据污染风险。

papers.title: Spectral Braids: A Topological Descriptor for Dynamic Directed Networks
papers.abstract: Eigenvalues are a workhorse of graph machine learning: spectral clustering, spectral graph neural networks, and graph kernels all summarize a network by the eigenvalues of a matrix. These eigenvalues are almost always treated as a static list of numbers. When a graph changes, however, its eigenvalues move, and when the matrix is not symmetric, they move in the complex plane, where they can wind around each other. papers.tldr_zh: 提出谱辫拓扑描述子，追踪动态有向网络快照的复特征值缠绕模式，用于刻画网络演化。

papers.title: Beyond urban boundaries: Percolation reveals land-consumptive growth in India
papers.abstract: Cities often extend beyond their administrative boundaries, complicating assessments of urban sustainability. Using Global Human Settlement Layer data for India's 50 largest urban agglomerations (1975--2025), we develop a percolation-based framework for urban delineation. Within district-based regions, we apply unrestricted DBSCAN to spatial coordinates of 100-m cells with positive population and built-up surface. We treat neighborhood distance as the percolation control parameter and the proportion of eligible cells in the largest connected cluster as the empirical order parameter. Sharp incr
papers.tldr_zh: 用渗流框架和DBSCAN对印度50个大都市区1975–2025年建成区做界定，发现城市边界外溢与连通跃迁。

papers.title: Supervising the search process produces reliable and generalizable information-seeking agents
papers.abstract: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) are transforming web search by shifting from document ranking to synthesizing answers, and are increasingly deployed as autonomous agentic search systems that iteratively interact with external knowledge sources. Despite this progress, building effective search agents remains challenging because high-quality intermediate search steps are difficult to generate. Previous approaches have primarily relied on outcome supervision, rewarding agents only for producing correct final answers. This often leads to reward hacking and excessive dependence on parametric
papers.tldr_zh: 提出RAG-Gym，对LLM搜索智能体的搜索过程而非仅最终答案进行监督，提升泛化能力。

papers.title: Interplay Between Network Heterogeneity and Activation Thresholds in Global Cascades
papers.abstract: The onset of global cascades in complex networks depends on both the distribution of activation thresholds and the underlying network topology. Here we investigate how these two sources of heterogeneity interact within the Watts threshold model, using beta-distributed activation thresholds and beta-binomial degree distributions to systematically vary their respective properties. Analyzing the onset of cascades from infinitesimal seeds, we identify two distinct boundaries governing the large-connectivity behavior of vulnerable branching. The first separates regimes in which increasing connectiv
papers.tldr_zh: 在Watts阈值模型中用beta分布阈值与beta-binomial度分布系统改变异质性，识别出全局级联起始的两类边界。

papers.title: Low-vocality engagement and participation dynamics on Bluesky
papers.abstract: Online participation is often measured through visible expression, especially posting, yet consequential forms of engagement also occur through less vocal actions such as liking and following. We study how users inhabit Bluesky by reconstructing participation profiles from more than three billion activity records produced by a near-complete sample accounting for more than 80% of registered users. Aggregating behavior into monthly user-level observations, we distinguish two dimensions often conflated in platform analytics: intensity, capturing how much users engage, and style, capturing how eng
papers.tldr_zh: 用Bluesky超30亿条活动记录重建用户参与画像，区分参与强度与表达风格，发现低发帖不等于低参与。

papers.title: The Hidden Costs of Gatekeeping in Open Science: Quasi-Experimental Evidence from arXiv's Endorsement Policy Tightening
papers.abstract: Preprint servers and open science platforms have become core infrastructure through which scientific knowledge circulates on the Web, greatly facilitating the dissemination and diffusion of online scientific information. Yet to safeguard content quality, many of these platforms rely on existing members to vouch for newcomers; how such network-mediated gatekeeping reshapes entry barriers across different scientific communities remains systematically underexplored. To address this, I examine the potential unequal impacts of this mechanism through arXiv's tightening of its endorsement policy in e
papers.tldr_zh: 利用arXiv 2026年收紧背书政策的准实验，结合三百万论文元数据与合著网络，发现网络化守门加剧新进入者壁垒且影响不均。

papers.title: Multiplex relational event models of self-reported and perceived gossip
papers.abstract: Gossiping is a complex social phenomenon that unfolds through multiple types of relations. Among other things, individuals may initiate gossiping about others as a result of believing themselves to be the target of gossip. These two processes, i.e., gossiping and gossip perception, form a dynamic multiplex network, where self-reported and perceived gossip ties coexist and can influence each other over time. We develop a multiplex relational event model to study the joint evolution of these two processes. The proposed model includes endogeneous covariates that capture the influence of events oc
papers.tldr_zh: 构建多层关系事件模型，联合建模44所中学中自报八卦与感知被八卦两类关系的动态相互影响。

papers.title: High Scores, Hidden Failures: Evaluating Codebook-Based LLM Content Analysis
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for codebook-based content analysis in computational social science, where codebooks translate theoretical concepts into labeling schemes. While prior work reports strong predictive performance, it remains unclear whether these systems produce reliable and robust text annotations. We conduct a large-scale empirical failure-mode analysis of LLM-based coding pipelines across four datasets and five models by systematically evaluating their stability, robustness, and conceptual validity under controlled perturbations, domain shifts, and optimizati
papers.tldr_zh: 在四个数据集和五个模型上系统扰动测试LLM编码本内容分析流程，发现高聚合分数下普遍存在标签级不稳定与概念效度失效。

papers.title: Investigating Forecasting Capabilities of Narrative Networks on Emerging Stories
papers.abstract: Networks have been used to model the interactions among the elements that underlie a narrative. In this paper, we investigate whether the structure of these networks can predict which links will emerge as a storyline evolves. We construct these networks from news articles using a Semantic Edge Parser (SEP) built on a Large Language Model (LLM), and evaluate the networks on three disparate real-world storylines, the 2022 Canadian Freedom Convoy, Hurricane Melissa (2025), and the 2025-26 Iranian protests. To test the narrative network's predictive capability, we construct a rolling window of the
papers.tldr_zh: 用LLM语义边解析器从新闻构建叙事网络，在三个真实事件上滚动预测次日新出现的叙事元素链接。

papers.title: Joint Independence Testing for Latent Position Random Graphs
papers.abstract: Kernel techniques are among the most powerful methods in data science and statistics. One of the key properties of kernels contributing to their numerous successful applications is that the associated reproducing kernel Hilbert space is expressive enough to encode probability distributions without loss of information or to capture the joint independence of $M\ge 2$ random variables, under mild conditions. papers.tldr_zh: 提出针对潜在位置随机图的联合独立性核检验方法，具有O(n^-1/2)收敛率，适用于社会学等网络数据。

papers.title: From Data Footprints to Researcher Fingerprints: Temporal Ego-centric Research Group Detection in Scientific Knowledge Graphs
papers.abstract: Understanding who researchers collaborate with, when and how their research groups form, and how these evolve over time is a foundational prerequisite for constructing multidimensional, evidence-based researcher fingerprints -- a requirement that has become increasingly urgent in the context of ongoing reforms in research evaluation advocated by initiatives such as DORA, the Leiden Manifesto, and CoARA. In this paper, we propose an egocentric approach for fine-grained research group detection, operating at the scale of individual researchers' ego networks, as extracted from Scientific Knowledg
papers.tldr_zh: 在科学知识图谱上以自我中心网络检测研究者随时间变化的科研团队，构建研究者指纹。

papers.title: AskGLP1: A Knowledge Graph LLM Agent for Exploring GLP-1 Experience from Online Patient Narratives
papers.abstract: GLP-1 medications are increasingly used for weight management, and many people share their experiences online. These narratives show why people take the drugs and what they experience, but they remain unstructured and disconnected from formal pharmacovigilance. We therefore present AskGLP1, a system that transforms online patient narratives into a knowledge graph (KG) and answers questions about medication experiences. Through an LLM-assisted pipeline grounded in the MedDRA terminology, AskGLP1 screens nearly 8.5 million Reddit posts for medication experiences and distills 163,135 of them, wit
papers.tldr_zh: 用LLM流水线将850万Reddit帖与WebMD评论提炼为38万条药物-副作用关系知识图谱，发现GLP-1体验因来源和药物而异。

papers.title: Populations, exposures and outcomes: How social media data is poised to advance climate-demography research
papers.abstract: As the natural environment continues to change, there is a shared sense among researchers, policymakers, and health practitioners that we need to better understand the impacts of those changes on health and health behaviors for individuals and populations. “Big” social media data, including large datasets from platforms like X (formerly Twitter), Reddit, Facebook, TikTok, and YouTube, provide access to previously hard-to-reach populations. These data are posed to revolutionize the data landscape in climate change research; however, there are limitations and ethical concerns with data from thes
papers.venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
papers.tldr_zh: 综述社交媒体大数据在气候-人口研究中的机遇，指出可触及难达人群但存在伦理、偏差与边缘群体代表性不足问题。

papers.title: Dynamics of collective creativity in AI art competitions
papers.abstract: Abstract Creativity is a fundamental part of cultural evolution, but the mechanisms by which groups produce novelty are notoriously difficult to infer from the historical record. Iterated learning experiments have shown that cultural transmission reliably distorts artifacts toward the inductive biases of learners, but most of this work uses linear chains of human participants, and it is unclear how these dynamics play out in the networked, human-AI systems that increasingly shape cultural production. papers.tldr_zh: 分析Artbreeder上368场“混音派对”的13万余张图像，揭示人机协作网络中集体创造力的分支演化动态。

papers.title: Surveillance Path Dependence: Technological and Institutional Lock-In of Digital Surveillance Infrastructures in China
papers.abstract: Digital surveillance infrastructures are widely critiqued for their use-side problems of access, privacy, and discrimination, but meaningful intervention requires understanding how these infrastructures are developed and stabilized in the first place. This paper examines China’s health code systems (HCSs) as a revelatory case of path dependence in the development of digital surveillance infrastructures. papers.tldr_zh: 以中国健康码系统为案例，通过新闻、访谈与田野调查追踪数字监控基础设施如何嵌入支付宝和微信生态并形成技术与制度锁定。

papers.title: Developmental asymmetries in equilibrium selection
papers.abstract: Abstract Coordination problems are central to social and economic life and often involve multiple equilibria. Classical theories identify two canonical principles for equilibrium selection: maximizing payoffs and minimizing strategic risk. These principles differ in what they demand of a decision-maker: payoff-based coordination can be reached by recognizing that one equilibrium pays more, whereas risk-based coordination requires reasoning about what happens when coordination fails. papers.tldr_zh: 用2000余名10-20岁被试玩两个协调博弈并陈述理由，发现均衡选择中收益原则与风险原则的使用随年龄发展呈不对称变化。

papers.title: The Community Archive: An Ethically Sourced X (Twitter) Dataset
papers.abstract: We present The Community Archive, a novel dataset of over 5 million posts from the social media site X (previously known as Twitter). In contrast with other large scale social media datasets, which are generally assembled without user consent via web scrapers, The Community Archive uses an opt-in model to obtain author consent for every post in the dataset. This enables us to release both the metadata and the content of users' posts at a previously unprecedented scale. Our dataset supports work in a wide variety of domains, including social network analysis, narrative tracking, and diachronic
papers.tldr_zh: 发布500万条经用户明示同意采集的X帖子数据集，含元数据与正文，并示例分析内容同质性。

papers.title: Network topology shapes consensus and vulnerability in LLM populations
papers.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) are deployed in interacting populations, their collective behaviour depends not only on the models but also on who interacts with whom. Studies of convention formation in LLM populations have mainly tested well-mixed interactions. We place policies extracted from four LLMs on fully connected, random regular, and heterogeneous networks, with $10^3$ to $10^5$ agents playing the naming game. papers.tldr_zh: 将四个LLM策略置于不同网络拓扑中玩命名博弈，发现拓扑影响共识速度、是否达成及对对抗的脆弱性。

papers.title: A phase transition for the strength of weak ties
papers.abstract: Abstract Granovetter's ``strength of weak ties'' argument links local triadic closure to the global importance of weak relationships, but it does not by itself quantify when strong ties can or cannot sustain large-scale connectivity. We study the subgraph formed by strong ties under a uniform, edgewise closure condition. A strong-tie graph is called p-transitive when, for every ordered adjacent pair (A,B), at least a fraction p of the strong neighbors of B other than A are also strong neighbors of A. papers.title: Core-periphery structure induces double phase transitions in information cascades
papers.abstract: Double phase transitions in spreading processes are commonly associated with additional dynamical or structural complexity. Here, we show that such transitions can emerge naturally in prevalent networks exhibiting a core-periphery (CP) organization. Specifically, we consider threshold-driven spreading on CP networks constructed from the stochastic block model, which is characterized by three parameters: the relative core size $r$, the CP coupling strength $μ$, and the fraction of intra-block link allocation $α$. papers.title: Causal asymmetry suggests productivity underlies scientific collaboration
papers.abstract: Abstract Scientific productivity and collaboration are closely related, yet the causal direction between these two dimensions of academic careers remains unclear. Here we analyze the careers of 26,876 Brazilian researchers holding a nationally prestigious fellowship across multiple disciplines to test whether productivity shapes collaboration or the reverse. papers.tldr_zh: 用因果发现框架分析2.7万巴西学者，发现生产力驱动合作而非相反。

papers.title: From lifestyle to citizenship: Social influence and political consumerism in egocentric networks
papers.abstract: Political consumerism has become a widespread form of civic engagement, yet the social mechanisms driving boycotting and buycotting remain insufficiently understood. This study investigates how perceived citizenship norms within individuals’ egocentric networks are associated with their own civic orientations and subsequent participation in consumer activism. Using a national survey of 543 U.S. adults reporting on 1822 social ties, we integrate social learning and social influence theories to examine how network environments cultivate engaged and dutiful citizenship norms. papers.tldr_zh: 基于543名美国人的自我中心网络调查，发现感知网络公民规范与个人规范强相关，参与型规范预测抵制与购买行为。

papers.title: X-pressing Intimacy: Mental Health Disclosure After Twitter Acquisition
papers.abstract: Social media platforms provide spaces for individuals to disclose mental health experiences and seek support, yet how these disclosures evolve during major shifts in platform governance remains unclear. We examine mental health self-disclosure surrounding Elon Musk's October 2022 acquisition of Twitter, analyzing approximately 824K tweets across anxiety, depression, bipolar disorder (BD), borderline personality disorder (BPD), and suicidal ideation (SI) or related experiences, alongside 266K comparison tweets. papers.title: Condensation and optimal targeting of repeated forcing in heterogeneous networks
papers.abstract: Many networks receive repeated external forcing through a subset of entry nodes, for example infections imported from another population, information seeded by a campaign, or invasive species arriving through ports. We study how concentrating such forcing on important entry nodes, with seeding probability $π_i\propto w_i^γ$, changes the size of the resulting cascades in a stochastic SIR model on bipartite networks. papers.title: Geospatial Dynamics of Online Attention to Nuclear Power in Japan Before and After Fukushima
papers.abstract: Nuclear power is increasingly seen as necessary for sustainable development, but this role depends on informed public engagement and support. Building this support requires understanding what citizens want to know, as reflected in their spontaneous online searches. To map this demand, we present the first long-term (2004-2024), prefecture-level analysis of Google Trends data on nuclear power in Japan. papers.tldr_zh: 分析日本2004-2024年县级搜索数据，发现核能关注呈宿主地模式，福岛事故后短暂转为距离衰减。

papers.title: From friction to alignment: Algorithmic imaginaries and the Trump autocomplete controversy on Reddit
papers.abstract: Employing topic modelling, this study analyses a collection of 157 submissions and 10,032 comments from Reddit surrounding users’ perceptions of censorship and bias by Google's autocomplete function following the Trump assassination attempt in July 2024. The discussions are examined through the framing of ‘friction of relevance’, operationalised as the tension between the expectations of individual users and algorithmic moderation by search engines, the strategies users employ to navigate it, and the outcomes when the friction is not resolved. papers.tldr_zh: 用主题模型分析Reddit上1.5万余条关于Google自动补全审查争议的讨论，揭示用户如何审计算法并受算法想象影响。
